inputs.text: The International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and all future Games. IOC president Kirsty Coventry is framing it as a matter of fairness by keeping biological males out of women's events, but this is just another institutional power play to enforce exclusion on some of the most marginalized people in sports. It doubles down on the deeper structural inequalities and historical discrimination that already push trans and DSD individuals to the margins, favoring rigid biological categories over protecting vulnerable groups or advancing real inclusion. These bodies keep choosing exclusion instead of dismantling barriers, and it's the kind of regressive policy we have to challenge head-on with everything we've got.
